newsitem.title: CHINA: China to develop $361 mln coal mine in Xinjiang.
newsitem.headline: China to develop $361 mln coal mine in Xinjiang.

text.p: China's northwestern region of Xinjiang is to start work on a 3.0 billion yuan ($361 million) coal mine to help ease coal shortages in the area, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.
The new mine in Kuqa county would have a production capacity of four to five million tonnes of coal a year, most of which would be sold to energy-starved southern parts of Xinjiang, Xinhua said.
The first phase of the project involves an open-pit mine with a production capacity of 1.5 million tonnes a year, the agency said.
Authorities also planned to build a thermal power plant with a capacity of 1,200 megawatts after the mine was completed, it said but gave no further details.
